items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: And I'll tell you another trumpet player was up there, Edward Klim. I don't know.

ctx.x: See? That's why I said they should have got the credit, but we beat them to the punch. Because we used to buy, because five, six guys in the band, seven guys in a string band was a big band. Everyone in that band would join that club for a dollar a month, didn't we? Right. Yeah. Like you get two of the same numbers, you get two numbers of the same numbers, we ain't got to trade with you for one of the, see? See? See? Bands got along, see? You had to go somewhere and play some quadrules or know something you had…
That's right. The fastest talking about him. See, but he had a band.
